title: Email: Fw: Please add subscription info to your writer tagline

content.subject: Fw: Please add subscription info to your writer tagline

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Alter, Marlowe <malter@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, August 13, 2020 8:36 PM
To: DFP_Sports <DFP_Sports@freepress.com>
Subject: Please add subscription info to your writer tagline 
 
Hi folks:
We’re off to a nice start driving subscriptions. We have a few ideas to help.
Here’s what we need you to do whenever you log back into Presto. It’ll take one minute:
Please copy+paste this pitch to your tagline:
The Free Press has started a new digital subscription model. Here's how you can gain access to our most exclusive YOUR TEAM content.
So for example, Birkett’s would be:  “ “ “  to our most exclusive Lions content.

Change that second blue hyperlink to your name at the end. So mine is (when you click that second sentence): https://cm.freep.com/specialoffer?gps-source=CPNEWS&utm_medium=onsite&utm_source=news&utm_campaign=NEWSROOM&utm_content=marlowealter
You can find your tagline if you:
Click on your name in Presto top right of screen, then click my profile.
Tagline is at very bottom. Scroll all the way down. Add this after your twitter/email.
Click blue save button at top right.
Bingo. The next time you create a slug, you should see your updated tagline include this pitch.
Any questions, let us know - I’m back Saturday, so ask Chris or Kirk 😊.
Detroit Free Press sports assistant editor
